notes: Zone: BLUE — Production / Mixing & Blending Room (per C.101 § 9.1 zone colour-coding)

All product-contact equipment (V-Blenders, Capsule Feeding Machine, Sieves/Screeners, Scoops & Utensils, Product Containers, Used Buckets) shall be cleaned using approved detergent, rinsed where required, dried, and sanitised with CHM-021 (Pure IPA) prior to use. Minimum sanitiser contact time: 5 minutes.
Pure IPA (CHM-021) is the primary sanitiser for Mixing/Blending Room per C-REG-001 Rev 06. Bastion IPA wipes (formerly CHM-002) have been REMOVED from the register (per Rev 06).
Cleaning verification: ATP swab per C.103 cadence on cleaning completion; record on C-FORM-008 (Daily ATP Log). Surfaces and thresholds per C-REG-004.
Cleaning tool colour: BLUE-coded mops, buckets, brushes per C.101 § 9.2. Tools dedicated to this zone — do not cross-use.
Per-shift execution records: C-FORM-002A1 (Daily), C-FORM-002A2 (Weekly), C-FORM-002A3 (Monthly Deep Clean).
Any deviation, OOS, or breakage → record on A-FORM-NCR-001 and escalate per A.006.

notes: Zone: ORANGE — Capsule Room (per C.101 § 9.1 zone colour-coding)

All product-contact equipment (Capsule Machine, Capsule Polisher, Capsule Feeding Machine, Sieves/Screeners, Scoops & Utensils, Product Containers, Used Buckets) shall be cleaned using approved detergent, rinsed where required, dried, and sanitised with CHM-021 (Pure IPA) prior to use. Minimum sanitiser contact time: 5 minutes.

Pure IPA (CHM-021) is the primary sanitiser for Capsule Room per C-REG-001 Rev 06 — fast-evaporation, no-residue, selected for dry-application capsule equipment. Inox MX3FG (CHM-007) is the only approved food-grade lubricant for capsule equipment.

Per-shift execution records: C-FORM-002B1 (Daily), C-FORM-002B2 (Weekly), C-FORM-002B3 (Monthly Deep Clean).
Any deviation, OOS, or breakage → record on A-FORM-NCR-001 and escalate per A.006.

notes: Zone: GREEN — Gummy Line (per C.101 § 9.1 zone colour-coding)

Gummy line cleaning operates on Pre-Op + Post-Prod cadence (per-batch), NOT Daily/Weekly/Monthly like Blending or Capsule. Execution forms: C-FORM-002C1 (Pre-Op), C-FORM-002C2 (Post-Prod), C-FORM-002C3 (Monthly Kettle CIP with CHM-022).

CHM-022 Chemron Sledge — heavy-duty caustic CIP detergent (Class 8 Corrosive, Schedule 6 Poison). Use ONLY for monthly kettle CIP per C-FORM-002C3. Full PPE per SDS mandatory. Locked Schedule 6 storage per Rev 06.

All product-contact equipment (depositor, hoppers, molds, conveyor, transfer pipes, kettle interior) shall be cleaned with food-grade detergent, rinsed with potable water, and sanitised before next run.

Cleaning verification: ATP swab per C.103 — kettle interior, depositor nozzles, hopper interior, mould surface, packaging contact are critical FCS (per C-REG-004). Per-run rotating swab + weekly full sweep + monthly extended.
Cleaning tool colour: GREEN-coded mops, buckets, brushes per C.101 § 9.2. Tools dedicated to gummy zone only.
Any deviation → A-FORM-NCR-001 + escalate per A.006.

Manufacturer requirements: clean at end of each shift; power OFF and heaters cooled first; do not spray water or steam directly onto the machine; never place tools or debris on worktable, conveyor or sealing jaws.
Lubricants (2# lithium grease) must be HI-approved and kept away from product / film-contact surfaces. Maintenance tasks are listed in Section D.

D. MAINTENANCE-LINKED TASKS (HI-VAL-EQP-001 § 12.2–12.3)
Task
Lubricate cross-seal bearings and drive chains / wheels (approved grease only)
Check chain and belt tension; tighten set screws and nuts
Inspect triangle belts and film-pulling synchronous belts; replace if worn
Inspect consumable parts and replace as needed
Check junction-board wiring; dry compressed air clean of frequency converter and circuit boards (power isolated)
